title: pvBlockIds
body:
## pvBlockIds

Adds a cell array named BlockIdScalars to every block of a multiblock dataset, holding the index of the block (unsigned char), so blocks can be coloured, thresholded or counted by block. The input must be a vtkMultiBlockDataSet; structure and other arrays are unchanged. Use extractBlock to keep selected blocks instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Partitioned dataset collections (e.g. from newer readers) are not multiblock; the input domain rejects them.
- The index is a traversal counter, not the block name; keep names via the reader's block list.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `BlockIds`. Identity: `filters/BlockIds`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Level Scalars filter. Accepted data: multiblock datasets (vtkMultiBlockDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkMultiBlockDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json

  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

{

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvBlockIds",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
